test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the opening range breakout with a 2% threshold fails to produce a directional movement persisting beyond the opening range when fees, realistic latency, slippage, and a fixed holdout are included in the out-of-sample test, then the hypothesis is falsified.
